title: Nourishing Smoky Irish Cod Pasta
description: A smoky and creamy Irish dish featuring cod, apricot, and pasta, perfect for a date night, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Bake the cod in the oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, combine the heavy cream, apricot jam, and grated parmesan.
Bring the cream mixture to a simmer over medium heat and let cook for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked pasta to the cream mixture and toss to combine.
Serve the pasta with the baked cod on top and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
